name: Content-gated positional embedding
tagline: Standard tied token+pos embedding, but the position embedding is element-wise multiplied by a sigmoid gate computed from each token's content.
diff_from_baseline: Keeps the tied-embedding baseline but inserts a single learned linear+sigmoid that token-conditionally rescales the position embedding before adding it to the token embedding; no value embeddings, no extra tables.

name: Multi-scale n-gram value injection
tagline: Adds an extra value embedding plus hashed bigram and trigram embeddings (each LayerNormed) injected at every transformer layer with per-layer per-source learnable gates.

key_hyperparams.name: n_value_tables
key_hyperparams.role: value-table V plus bigram and trigram

diff_from_baseline: Generalizes the value_embed and bigram_hash baselines: combines a unigram value table with bigram and trigram hashed tables, each LayerNormed, and gates them per-layer-per-source-per-dimension instead of value-only or bigram-only injection.

name: Dual-lexicon + depth-decayed n-gram
tagline: Per-token convex mix of two lexical embeddings (alt_wte vs wte) with a sigmoid gate, plus token-confidence-scaled bigram/trigram residuals injected at the input and three layers with decreasing scale.

key_hyperparams.name: layer_scales
key_hyperparams.role: depth-decayed scales s_i for the 3 injection layers

key_hyperparams.name: alt_wte_init_std
key_hyperparams.role: init for the second lexical table

init_recovers: Tied baseline at mix_gate=0 and ngram tables zero-init
diff_from_baseline: Combines and extends the untied + value_embed + bigram_hash baselines: token-wise convex mix of two embedding tables to give the lm_head a softly-untied weight, plus depth-decayed bigram and trigram residuals gated by per-token confidence and source-mixing scalars.
